add.name: aws-iam
add.purpose: Official AWS skill with verified corrections for IAM behaviours agents often get wrong (policy evaluation, trust policies, permission boundaries, SCPs) plus references.
add.how_to_use: Triggers when writing or debugging IAM policies/roles; part of aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws (installable as the aws-core plugin).
add.evidence: Official AWS (new Apr 2026 toolkit); skills.sh ~9k installs
add.notes: Same skill also shipped at plugins/aws-core/skills/aws-iam.

add.name: aws-containers
add.purpose: Official AWS skill for building and deploying containers on EKS, ECS, Fargate and ECR, including Karpenter and the AWS Load Balancer Controller.
add.how_to_use: Triggers on EKS/ECS/Fargate deployment work; requires AWS CLI credentials for live actions.
add.notes: Toolkit also has aws-serverless, aws-observability, aws-cdk; the existing awslabs/agent-plugins aws-lambda entry may be superseded by this repo.

add.name: ci-cd-and-automation
add.purpose: Sets up CI/CD pipelines with quality gates, test runners in CI, and deployment strategies (preview envs, rollbacks, feature flags).
add.how_to_use: Triggers when creating or changing build/deploy pipelines.
